# Jarvis help

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_helpfile.py from the code. Do not edit by hand: run `uv run python scripts/gen_helpfile.py`. -->

The complete reference for Jarvis 1.0.0: every command, every tool the model can use, the Telegram commands and the words Jarvis listens for. It is generated from the code, so it matches this version exactly. To change it, change the code (or `scripts/gen_helpfile.py`) and run `uv run python scripts/gen_helpfile.py`.

Start with [README.md](README.md); the steps you do by hand are in [MANUAL_STEPS.md](MANUAL_STEPS.md), and the guides are in [docs/](docs/README.md).

Contents: [Command line](#command-line) · [Tools](#tools) · [Telegram commands](#telegram-commands) · [Voice and chat phrases](#voice-and-chat-phrases)

## Command line

Every command is English in every language. Run `jarvis <command> --help` for the same text in the terminal. `jarvis` alone starts the chat.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `jarvis chat` | Interactive chat (default). |
| `jarvis setup` | First-run wizard: language, files, profile, API key, optional features (safe to run again). |
| `jarvis uninstall` | Remove the background services and, after asking, the Keychain entries and the local data. |
| `jarvis doctor` | Full health check. |
| `jarvis stats` | Turn and tool statistics. |
| `jarvis usage` | Tokens and cost. |
| `jarvis export` | Markdown transcript of a session. |
| `jarvis sessions` | List recent sessions. |
| `jarvis memory` | Long-term memory (data/memory.md): list the notes with their dates, or forget one. |
| `jarvis memory forget` | Remove every note containing this text. |
| `jarvis google` | Google OAuth (Calendar events, Gmail read and drafts only). |
| `jarvis google login` | Run the OAuth flow in the browser and store the token in the Keychain. |
| `jarvis google logout` | Remove the stored Google token. |
| `jarvis health` | Apple Health import (from the iCloud inbox or a full export). |
| `jarvis health sync` | Import new files from the Health inbox folder. |
| `jarvis health import` | Backfill from the Health app's 'Export All Health Data' zip. |
| `jarvis scheduler` | Background timer scheduler (launchd user agent). |
| `jarvis scheduler run` | Run the scheduler loop in the foreground. |
| `jarvis scheduler install` | Install the launchd agent so timers fire even when the CLI is closed. |
| `jarvis scheduler uninstall` | Remove the launchd agent. |
| `jarvis scheduler status` | Is the agent installed and running. |
| `jarvis alarms` | Alarms (different from timers): list, cancel, stop or snooze the one ringing, ring a test. |
| `jarvis alarms list` | Pending alarms and whether one is ringing (the default). |
| `jarvis alarms cancel` | Cancel an alarm by id or label ('all' cancels every alarm). |
| `jarvis alarms stop` | Stop the alarm that is ringing now. |
| `jarvis alarms snooze` | Snooze the ringing alarm (default alarm.snooze_min). |
| `jarvis alarms test` | Ring the alarm sound now, with the dialog and the volume, to try it out. |
| `jarvis brief` | The daily brief: agenda, weather, reminders, football, alarms. |
| `jarvis brief schedule` | The automatic morning brief: show the schedule and the next run, or turn it on/off. |
| `jarvis telegram` | Telegram bot interface (long polling, allowlisted user only). |
| `jarvis telegram run` | Run the bot in the foreground. |
| `jarvis telegram install` | Install the launchd agent that runs the bot in the background. |
| `jarvis telegram uninstall` | Remove the launchd agent. |
| `jarvis telegram status` | Agent status, kill switch state. |
| `jarvis telegram set-token` | Store the bot token in the Keychain. |
| `jarvis telegram whoami` | Setup mode: print the user id and chat id of the first message received. |
| `jarvis telegram enable` | Re-enable the bot after /stop (requires /start from the phone first). |
| `jarvis voice` | Hands-free voice service: wake word, hotkey, spoken replies (needs use_voice = true). |
| `jarvis services` | The launchd agents (scheduler, Telegram, voice) as one group. |
| `jarvis services reinstall` | Rewrite and reload every installed agent so it runs the current `jarvis` binary. |
| `jarvis services status` | Which binary the agents run, and whether each one is installed and running. |
| `jarvis dashboard` | The local monitoring and settings page in the browser (127.0.0.1 only; runs in this terminal until Ctrl-C). |
| `jarvis shortcuts` | Apple Shortcuts: which ones exist on this Mac and which are allowlisted for Jarvis. |
| `jarvis shortcuts list` | List every Shortcut on this Mac and mark the allowlisted ones (copy names into config.toml). |
| `jarvis network` | Internet test and history: what the internet_test tool does, from the terminal. |
| `jarvis network test` | Diagnostics plus the networkQuality speed test (about 20 s); --quick skips the speed test. |
| `jarvis network history` | Averages, worst times and failures from the stored tests. |
| `jarvis presence` | "am I home" / "who is home": setup, status, one scan. |
| `jarvis presence setup` | Interactive, at home: save the router's MAC as the home network and pick your phone and other devices. |
| `jarvis presence status` | Home network, people and their states, last scan. |
| `jarvis presence scan` | Run one presence scan now (normally the scheduler agent does this every scan_interval_s). |
| `jarvis calendar` | Calendar settings: the [[calendar.filters]] and what they hide. |
| `jarvis calendar filters` | List the active calendar filters and the events they hide in the coming days. |
| `jarvis location` | The Current Location Jarvis uses (where you are now, not your home Location): show it, or refresh it. |
| `jarvis completion` | Print a shell completion script for the jarvis subcommands. |
| `jarvis key` | Manage secrets in the macOS Keychain. |
| `jarvis key set` | Store a secret (prompts for the value). |
| `jarvis key delete` | Remove a secret. |

### `jarvis`

Without a command: the interactive chat. These options work before any command.

```
jarvis [--debug] [--version] [<command>]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--debug` | off | Show thinking, API payloads (in the log) and timings. |
| `--version` | off | Show the version, git commit and home directory. |

Examples:

```
jarvis
jarvis --debug
jarvis --version
```

### `jarvis chat`

Interactive chat (default).

```
jarvis chat [--debug]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--debug` | off | Same as the top-level --debug. |

Example:

```
jarvis chat
```

### `jarvis setup`

First-run wizard: language, files, profile, API key, optional features (safe to run again).

```
jarvis setup [--language] [--answers FILE] [--no-doctor]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--language` | off | Only choose the main language (English or Turkish). |
| `--answers FILE` |  | Run without questions from a TOML answers file (language, name, address_as, home_location, daily_budget_usd). |
| `--no-doctor` | off | Do not run `jarvis doctor` at the end. |

Examples:

```

jarvis setup --language
jarvis setup --answers answers.toml --no-doctor
```

### `jarvis brief`

The daily brief: agenda, weather, reminders, football, alarms.

```

```

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--date DATE` | `today` | The day: today, tomorrow or YYYY-MM-DD (default today). |
| `--send {telegram,voice}` |  | Send the brief to this channel now (the automatic brief's versions). One of: `telegram`, `voice`. |
| `--raw` | off | Print the assembled data instead of the model's summary. |

Examples:

```

```

The automatic morning brief: show the schedule and the next run, or turn it on/off.


| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `<state>` |  | Write enabled = true/false to config.local.toml. One of: `on`, `off`. |

Examples:

```

jarvis brief schedule off
```

### `jarvis voice`

Hands-free voice service: wake word, hotkey, spoken replies (needs use_voice = true).

```
jarvis voice [{run,install,uninstall,status,pause,resume,calibrate,debug-record,test-stt,list-voices,set-elevenlabs-key,say}] [text ...] [--dry-run] [--language {tr,en}] [--foreground] [--seconds SECONDS] [--out DIR] [--compare DIR] [--engines LIST] [--cloud] [--download] [--verbose] [--for DURATION]
```

| Argument | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `<command>` | `status` | Status (default) shows the agent and whether it listens; run starts the service in this terminal; install/uninstall the launchd agent; pause/resume stop and restart wake-word listening without touching the agent; calibrate shows live wake-word scores; debug-record records one utterance like the service, saves the WAV the STT engine gets and prints its levels and transcript; test-stt records 15 sentences once and scores every speech-to-text option on them (word and name accuracy, latency, cost); list-voices prints the ElevenLabs voices on your account (name + id); set-elevenlabs-key stores the API key in the Keychain; say speaks a text through the configured engine after the spoken-form normalization (numbers, times, dates as words). One of: `run`, `install`, `uninstall`, `status`, `pause`, `resume`, `calibrate`, `debug-record`, `test-stt`, `list-voices`, `set-elevenlabs-key`, `say`. |
| `<text>` |  | `say`: the text to speak (quote it). |
| `--dry-run` | off | `say`: only print the normalized text, speak nothing. |
| `--language {tr,en}` |  | `say`: force the language instead of detecting it per sentence. One of: `tr`, `en`. |
| `--foreground` | off | Print every state change, transcript, reply and timing. |
| `--seconds SECONDS` | `30.0` | `calibrate`: how long to listen. |
| `--out DIR` |  | `debug-record`: folder for the WAV (default: a new temp folder). |
| `--compare DIR` |  | `test-stt`: score an earlier session (data/stt_test/&lt;stamp&gt;) instead of recording. |
| `--engines LIST` |  | `test-stt`: comma-separated option keys (current, current+hints, large-v3, turkish, apple, elevenlabs, hybrid ...). |
| `--cloud` | off | `test-stt`: also send the recordings to ElevenLabs Scribe (paid, audio leaves the Mac). |
| `--download` | off | `test-stt`: download the Whisper models that are not cached yet (large-v3 and the Turkish model are about 3 GB each). |
| `--verbose` | off | `test-stt`: print every transcript under the table. |
| `--for DURATION` |  | `pause`: listen again automatically after this long (60m, 1h, 1h30m, 90). |

Examples:

```
jarvis voice
jarvis voice status
jarvis voice run --foreground
jarvis voice install
jarvis voice uninstall
jarvis voice pause --for 1h
jarvis voice resume
jarvis voice calibrate --seconds 20
jarvis voice debug-record --out ~/Desktop/jarvis-debug
jarvis voice test-stt
jarvis voice test-stt --compare data/stt_test/SESSION --verbose
jarvis voice list-voices
jarvis voice set-elevenlabs-key
jarvis voice say "The meeting starts at 14:30" --dry-run
jarvis voice say "Merhaba Ada" --language tr
```

## Tools

What Jarvis can do for you. You never call a tool by name: ask in your own words (English or Turkish) and the model picks the tool. **Risk**: Safe runs directly, Confirm asks you first (a dialog, a spoken "confirm" or the Telegram buttons), Blocked never runs. **Taints**: the tool returns outside content (mail, web pages, calendars), which is marked untrusted, and later actions in that turn may need your confirmation. **Telegram**: offered from the phone by default (`telegram.remote_allowed_tools`).

88 tools in 28 groups.

### Alarms

| Tool | What it does | Risk | Taints | Telegram |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cancel_alarm` | Cancel a pending alarm by id, label or clock time ('cancel the alarm', 'remove the 7:30 alarm'). | Safe | No | Yes |
| `list_alarms` | List the pending alarms with their times, repeats and phone backup, and whether one is ringing now. | Safe | No | Yes |
| `set_alarm` | Set an alarm at a clock time ('set an alarm', 'wake me at 7', 'get me up at 6:30'). | Safe | No | Yes |
| `snooze_alarm` | Snooze the alarm that is ringing right now ('snooze', '10 more minutes'): it rings again after the given minutes (default 9). | Safe | No | Yes |
| `stop_alarm` | Stop the alarm that is ringing right now ('turn off the alarm', 'stop', 'ok I'm up'). | Safe | No | Yes |

| Tool | Say (English) | Söyle (Türkçe) |
|---|---|---|
| `cancel_alarm` | “Cancel the 7:30 alarm”<br>“Remove all my alarms” | “7.30 alarmını iptal et”<br>“Bütün alarmları sil” |
| `list_alarms` | “Which alarms do I have?”<br>“Is an alarm set for tomorrow?” | “Hangi alarmlarım var?”<br>“Yarın için alarm kurulu mu?” |
| `set_alarm` | “Wake me up at 7 tomorrow”<br>“Set an alarm for 6:30 on weekdays” | “Yarın beni 7'de uyandır”<br>“Hafta içi 6.30'a alarm kur” |
| `snooze_alarm` | “Snooze”<br>“Ten more minutes” | “Ertele”<br>“On dakika daha” |
| `stop_alarm` | “Turn off the alarm”<br>“OK, I'm up” | “Alarmı kapat”<br>“Tamam, kalktım” |

### Apple Shortcuts

Needs: At least one Shortcut under `[[shortcuts.allowed]]` in config.toml; hidden while the list is empty.

| Tool | What it does | Risk | Taints | Telegram |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list_shortcuts` | List the Apple Shortcuts Jarvis is allowed to run, with their descriptions and risk. | Safe | No | Yes |
| `run_shortcut` | Run one of the allowed Apple Shortcuts on the Mac (focus modes, Notes, Music, HomeKit scenes). | Safe or Confirm (per entry); asks after untrusted content | Per call | Yes |

| Tool | Say (English) | Söyle (Türkçe) |

| Tool | What it does | Risk | Taints | Telegram |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fetch_page` | Fetch a public web page and return its visible text (HTML is converted to text; plain text and JSON are returned as is). | Safe; asks after untrusted content | Yes | Yes |
| `web_search` | Search the web (runs on Anthropic's servers). Results are untrusted content. | Safe | Yes | Yes |

| Tool | Say (English) | Söyle (Türkçe) |
|---|---|---|
| `fetch_page` | “Read this page for me: https://example.com/article” | “Bu sayfayı benim için oku: https://example.com/article” |
| `web_search` | “Search the web for the opening hours of the city museum”<br>“What's the latest news on the election?” | “Şehir müzesinin çalışma saatlerini internette ara”<br>“Seçimle ilgili son haberler neler?” |

## Telegram commands

Send these to your bot from the phone (see docs/integrations/telegram.md). They are English in every language; anything else you type or say is a normal request.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/start` | Say hello; after /stop it is the first step to turn the bot back on (then `jarvis telegram enable` on the Mac). |
| `/help` | What Jarvis can do from the phone, and these commands. |
| `/new` | Start a new session (Jarvis forgets the running conversation, not its memory). |
| `/location` | Show the share-location button: remote weather and travel times then start from where you are. |
| `/mute [60m]` | Pause voice listening on the Mac, for a while or until /unmute. |
| `/unmute` | Resume voice listening on the Mac. |
| `/status` | The Mac's state: battery, idle time, screen lock (the `mac_status` tool). |
| `/lock` | Lock the Mac's screen (the `lock_screen` tool). |
| `/sleep [seconds]` | Put the Mac to sleep after a countdown of 3-120 s, with Approve / Decline buttons (the `sleep_mac` tool). |
| `/stop_alarm` | Stop the alarm ringing on the Mac. |
| `/snooze [min]` | Snooze the ringing alarm (1-60 minutes). |
| `/brief` | Send today's brief now. |
| `/stop` | Emergency off: the bot stops answering until /start here and `jarvis telegram enable` on the Mac. |

## Voice and chat phrases

Fixed words Jarvis listens for, by language. The alarm, sleep and confirmation words of every language work at any time. The exit words are what `jarvis setup` writes to `general.exit_words` for the chosen language.

| Phrase | English | Türkçe |
|---|---|---|
| Wake word | “Hey Jarvis” | “Hey Jarvis” |
| Push to talk (hold) | Option + Space (`<alt>+<space>`) | Option + Space (`<alt>+<space>`) |
| End the chat (whole input) | `exit`, `quit`, `bye` | `exit`, `quit`, `bye`, `çık`, `çıkış` |
| Refuse a confirmation | `no`, `nope`, `cancel`, `stop`, `dont`, `don't`, `never`, `reject`, `deny`, `abort` | `hayır`, `hayir`, `yok`, `iptal`, `vazgeç`, `vazgec`, `vazgeçtim`, `vazgectim`, `reddet`, `reddediyorum`, `onaylamıyorum`, `onaylamiyorum`, `onaylama`, `istemiyorum`, `yapma`, `dur`, `durdur`, `olmaz` |
| Not enough to confirm (asked again) | `yes`, `yeah`, `yep`, `sure`, `fine`, `right`, `ok`, `okay`, `please`, `jarvis` | `evet`, `tamam`, `olur`, `peki`, `he`, `hıhı`, `hihi`, `hı`, `aynen`, `okey`, `tabii`, `tabi`, `hadi`, `yap`, `ekle`, `onayla`, `onay`, `lütfen`, `jarvis`, `evet evet` |
| Stop a ringing alarm | `ok`, `okay`, `stop`, `stop alarm`, `stop the alarm`, `turn it off`, `turn off`, `off`, `enough`, `dismiss`, `i'm up`, `im up`, `i'm awake`, `im awake` | `tamam`, `tamam tamam`, `kapat`, `kapa`, `durdur`, `dur`, `sus`, `yeter`, `kalktım`, `uyandım`, `alarmı kapat`, `alarmı durdur`, `alarm kapat`, `alarmı sustur`, `sustur` |
| Snooze a ringing alarm | `snooze`, `later` | `ertele`, `biraz daha` |
| Cancel a Mac sleep countdown | `cancel`, `cancel it`, `stop`, `abort`, `no`, `don't sleep`, `dont sleep` | `iptal`, `iptal et`, `dur`, `vazgeç`, `vazgec`, `uyutma`, `uyuma`, `hayır` |

These lists are settings in config.toml and are heard in any language (defaults shown):

| Phrase | Setting | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Approve a spoken confirmation | `voice.confirm_phrases` | `onaylıyorum`, `evet onaylıyorum`, `confirm`, `yes confirm` |
| Pause listening | `voice.pause_phrases` | `sesi kapat`, `dinlemeyi durdur`, `stop listening` |
| Wake word model | `voice.wake_word_model` | `hey_jarvis` |
| Push-to-talk key | `voice.hotkey` | `<alt>+<space>` |
